SELECT b.id, b.brand_name, b.brand_logo, b.initial, b.sort_no, b.status, b.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_model m WHERE m.brand_id = b.id AND m.deleted = 0) AS model_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle v WHERE v.brand_id = b.id AND v.deleted = 0) AS vehicle_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle v WHERE v.brand_id = b.id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.status = 1) AS rentable_count FROM vehicle_brand b WHERE b.deleted = 0
AND b.status = #{q.status}
AND (b.brand_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR b.initial LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC
SELECT b.id, b.brand_name, b.brand_logo, b.initial, b.sort_no, b.status FROM vehicle_brand b WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.sort_no ASC, b.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item oi JOIN lease_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE oi.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId} AND o.status IN ('WAIT_PAY', 'WAIT_PICKUP', 'IN_USE', 'WAIT_RETURN', 'OVERDUE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_model WHERE brand_id = #{brandId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE brand_id = #{brandId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT store_id FROM vehicle WHERE id = #{vehicleId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_brand WHERE deleted = 0) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_brand WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS enabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle_brand WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0) AS disabled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE deleted = 0) AS vehicles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicle WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1) AS rentable

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN maint_type = 'MAINTAIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maintain, SUM(CASE WHEN maint_type = 'REPAIR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repair, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS cost FROM vehicle_maintenance WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date >= CURDATE() AND end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS soon, COALESCE(SUM(premium), 0) AS premium FROM vehicle_insurance WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1
